scope: Theorem 1.1 (Condensation in every ground state) of the manuscript “Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas” (preprints/Ground-state-condensation-in-the-dilute-hard-sphere-gas-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3f861f3b57ec1d6a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are absolute constants ε0, c0 > 0 with the following property. Fix a, ρ > 0 satisfying ρa3 < ε0. For every sequence of particle numbers Nk and lengths Lk such that Nk −→ ∞, Lk −→ ∞, Nk L3 k −→ ρ, and every choice of normalized, possibly complex, bosonic ground eigenvectors Ψk of the hard-sphere Hamiltonians, lim inf k→∞ B(Ψk) ≥ c0. (1.2)
